summary: First-finish smoke test for VOXX Sui NFT staking platform. Backend health, nonce, and admin tiers endpoints all return 200 with expected payloads. Frontend loads with correct VOXX branding, black/blue theme (#05050A bg), Unbounded heading font, IBM Plex Sans body font, connect wallet panel, feature cards, and footer. Post-auth UI (Stake/Dashboard/Admin tabs, stats cards, AdminPanel tier management) cannot be exercised without a Sui wallet browser extension and was deferred per the request.
passed: GET /api/admin/tiers -> 200 returns 4 default tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum) with multiplier, min_days, apy
Homepage loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with no console/runtime errors
VOXX STAKING branding + 'Sui Chain NFT Staking' subtitle visible
Black & blue theme applied (body bg rgb(5,5,10))
Unbounded font on H1, IBM Plex Sans on body
Connect Wallet panel renders with copy 'Use Sui Wallet, Suiet, or Slush to access your NFTs'
Three feature cards render (Multiple Reward Tiers, Instant Staking, Points System)
Footer text 'Powered by Sui Blockchain • Built with love for VOXX NFT Holders' present

failed.issue: Page <title> is the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of a VOXX-specific title
Connect wallet button and other interactive elements lack data-testid attributes, making robust automated testing harder
failed.evidence: Only 1 button found on landing page, testid=None, text='Connect Button'

action_items: Optional: set a proper <title> like 'VOXX Staking' in public/index.html
Optional: add data-testid attributes to ConnectButton, nav tabs, stake/unstake actions, and admin tier inputs for future testing
Wallet signature flow, NFT listing, stake/unstake, and AdminPanel updates require manual testing with a real Sui wallet extension on Devnet

notes.wallet_flow_skipped_reason: No Sui wallet browser extension available in headless test environment; per request, post-auth screens (Stake list, Dashboard stats cards, Admin tier management) were not exercised end-to-end.
